item.text: Hi, thanks for organizing our group walks! Could we consider a route with more benches for an upcoming outing, perhaps through a local park? Having places to pause would make the walk more comfortable for a wider range of participants, including anyone who needs occasional rest or prefers a gentler pace. We could still enjoy a good walk together, with opportunities to stop, chat, and appreciate the surroundings. I’d be happy to help look for a suitable route.
